### **II. Purpose and Scope of Valuation**

This statement provides a conservative, technically defensible estimate of the **marital interest** in Ridgeline Landscaping LLC as of the date of separation (or the most recent practicable valuation date, [Insert Date]). - Adjusted net earnings available for valuation: **$100,000 – $85,000 = $15,000/year**.

#### **C. Tangible Business Assets (Net of Depreciation)**
| Asset | Original Cost | Accum. Depreciation | Net Book Value |
|-------|---------------|----------------------|----------------|

> - If my spouse hires an appraiser, a self-prepared valuation may be contested, potentially leading to higher imputed value.
> - A qualified appraisal may still support a conservative value while adding objectivity.

### **VII. Certification**

I declare under penalty of perjury pursuant to Colorado law that the foregoing is true and correct to the best of my knowledge and belief. I understand that intentional misrepresentation may result in sanctions, reimbursement of attorney fees, or adjustment of property division by the court.

> H₁: μ > 72
